_comment: Gate 2 of 5: verification gates. Every build must pass ALL gates before presentation. Thresholds are defaults; a build spec may tighten, never loosen, them.

alpha.description: Image has visible (alpha > 0) pixels; fully transparent output fails.

bbox.description: Image has a non-empty content bounding box (not fully transparent / blank).

canvas_size.description: Canvas width/height match the spec exactly.
canvas_size.note: Set width/height per build spec. Null means SKIPPED, not PASS.

file_size.description: File size within sane bounds: not empty, and under the chat-playable cap for chat delivery (8 MB). Larger files must be delivered as a downscaled chat version plus the full file in the repo.

frame_count.description: Animation frame count matches the spec. For a still PNG, expected_frames = 1.

ground_feet.description: Feet / lowest content touches the expected ground band. ground_y is the expected ground line in pixels from the top; tolerance_px is allowed slack.
ground_feet.note: Set ground_y per build spec (e.g. chair-seat line for sit poses). If ground_y is null, check_gates.py reports this gate as SKIPPED, not PASS, and the build spec must supply it before presentation.
